verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Reflect letting users define their own event-triggered rules. Kindle sync, bookmark-to-daily-note, and transcription-to-daily-note are fixed built-in behaviors, and custom AI prompts are invoked manually. Zapier is a third-party tool that connects Reflect to other apps, so it is a user-side workaround rather than Reflect's own rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
